_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_experiment: Template for tools/mlp_gsearch: Google on golden_small_incl. gsearch.py copies it into shard descriptors with their own simulations and gi<I>_gd<D> configurations; run as is, it runs the base config only.
_workload_manager: manual: run the simulations on this machine, at most max_parallel at a time
_max_parallel: gsearch.py sets each shard's to min(sims, 192); cloudhost sets it to the core count on cloud machines.
_container_reuse: One reused container per slot instead of one per sim.
_root_dir: Output goes to <root_dir>/simulations/<experiment>, on the storage drive.
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: A private clone of matthewpipie/scarab main, so sci's in-place hash checkouts cannot disturb a working checkout.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces, resolved as <traces_dir>/<suite>/<subsuite>/<workload>.
_top_simpoint: The 6 highest-weight simpoints of each workload, weights renormalized to sum to 1.
_simulations: All 12 google workloads, top 6 simpoints, 50M warmup + 200M measured (--inst_limit 250000000 in the base params; inst_limit counts the warmup).
_configurations: Exactly one configuration: the binary and the base params every gamma point adds --mlp_lin_instr_lambda / --mlp_lin_data_lambda to. REPL_MLP with main's countdown defaults (tiered, no_revive) and marking defaults.

base._params: REPL_MLP on the MLC, 50M warmup + 200M measured.
